up: Retrieve all distinct compounds that are reported in the document (publication/dataset) identified by the ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5604062. For each compound, provide the following columns: the compound's ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), its preferred name (if any), and its canonical SMILES (if available). Use the compound_records table as the link between the document (docs) and the molecule (molecule_dictionary). Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5604062';
